summary: New York City resident, systems software engineer with expertise in C, C++, Python, and FPGA development, former high-frequency trading engineer, strong interest in supply chain management and optimization, experienced in performance optimization and hardware/software co-design, advocates for educational reform in STEM, critical of current political and social systems, engaged in discussions about cryptocurrency and its implications, enjoys playing chess and has experience with card games like bridge, holds strong opinions on the impact of government policies on economic systems, and has a nuanced understanding of technology and its societal implications.
